games.desc:
⚠️ THERE MAY BE BUGS!

Facepunch Studios & Valve: Assets.
JetBoom: Original Gamemode Inspiration.

💻 Controls:
M - Menu.
B - Shop
E - Interact.
F - Flashlight.
T - Chat.
CTRL - Crouch.

Do You have what it takes to survive all 6 waves?

Zombie Survival Garry's Mod is a game where a group of Survivors are present in an apocalyptic world with a threat of an incoming zombie horde hungry for their brains. Humans must prepare and work together and fight-off the zombies in order to prevail.

Work together with other survivors, create barricades using Carpenter's Hammer, cooperate, defeat Mini-Bosses, heal eachother using Medkits, and purchase arsenal of powerful weapons to gain an upperhand in-game.

🧗 Welcome to Fling to Climb! 🎉
Can you master the art of flinging and reach the top? Grab, launch, and conquer the ultimate climbing challenge! 🚀

[THIS GAME WILL CAUSE A PHENOMENON KNOWN AS RAGING, BE ADVISED!😡]

🔹 Click & Hold onto rock walls to grip!
🔹 Release while moving the mouse/screen to launch yourself upward! 🎯
🔹 Navigate through obstacles like lava, ice, and wind! ❄️🔥💨
🔹 Reach checkpoints to save your progress! 🏁
🔹 Collect coins and roll for awesome skins! 💰🎲

Welcome to Princess Tycoon 😄, choose your favorite princess 👸 and build 🧱 your tycoon! 

You purchase droppers 🏗️ that generate cash 💸, when you have enough cash you will be able to unlock different weapons ⚔️ of your chosen princess and unlock the princess outfit 👗.
